headline: Claude Code marketplace auto-update starts November 30, while Antigravity CLI 1.5.16 and Codex 0.172.0 add resume and MCP startup changes.

themes.title: New defaults change model, sandbox and effort behavior
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.326 stops sandboxed commands from writing to some home folders by default, and Claude Code 2.1.331 auto-updates managed plugin marketplaces from November 30 unless you set `autoUpdate` to false ([v2.1.326](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326), [v2.1.331](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.331)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.15 defaults Orchestrator effort to high, Codex 0.171.0 makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default model, and Codex 0.172.0 starts optional stdio MCP servers on their first tool call ([1.5.15](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.15), [rust-v0.171.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.171.0), [rust-v0.172.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.172.0)).
themes.so_what: pin the marketplace and effort settings you rely on, and re-check unattended jobs for blocked paths, MCP startup order and the default model.

themes.title: Saved scheduled tasks need a new schedule
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.329 makes most scheduled tasks saved by earlier versions need scheduling again in new signed-in sessions, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them ([v2.1.329](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329)).
themes.so_what: schedule saved tasks again, or they may not run in new sessions.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.328 closes an MCP header leak on redirect and a sandbox network-rule bypass ([v2.1.328](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.14 fixes a Windows credential leak through UNC paths ([1.5.14](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.14)). Codex 0.170.0 keeps sandbox restrictions through permission updates and child threads ([rust-v0.170.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.170.0)). Kilo Code v7.8.32 carries the hono and node-forge security updates ([v7.8.32](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.32)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.328 or later, Antigravity CLI to 1.5.14 or later and Kilo Code to 7.8.32 or later.

watch_next: Watch the next Antigravity CLI notes for how Auto mode's outside-workspace writes behave, and the next Codex CLI notes for the Code Mode gRPC change and any removal of code_mode_host_grpc.
